definitions.explanation: A rule or area where smoking is not allowed.
The act of stopping the habit of smoking.

notes:
{禁煙|きんえん} has two meanings: no-smoking zones and the act of quitting smoking.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- No standard transitive pair
- Pattern: {禁煙|きんえん}する

NO-SMOKING MEANING:
- {禁煙|きんえん}⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (non-smoking seat)
- {禁煙|きんえん}⟦{車両|しゃりょう}→車両：05297_sharyou⟧ (non-smoking car)
- ⟦{全面|ぜんめん}→全面：22735_zenmen⟧{禁煙|きんえん} (completely smoke-free)

QUITTING MEANING:
- {禁煙|きんえん}する (to quit smoking)

- {禁煙|きんえん}⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧ (in the process of quitting)
